thread:
maria: hitting a confusing one in the Go SDK sampleapp: generator stream doesn't stop when ctx.Cancel() is called if an auth refresh happens mid-stream.

maria: Minimal repro: 
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
stream, _ := client.Generators.Generate(ctx, req)
// background token refresher may run
cancel()
for c := range stream.Chunks() {
  fmt.Println(c) // still prints for several seconds after cancel
}
```

maria: logs show 401 -> refresh -> retry and the retry path keeps delivering chunks even after ctx.Err() != nil.

sam: is the refresher modifying the RoundTripper header, or doing a sync refresh on the request goroutine?

maria: transport wrapper swaps Authorization header; retryAuth() rebuilds a request and sets headers. Suspect new req doesn't use original ctx.

john: yup, if retry builds a new http.Request without req.WithContext(origCtx) the cancel won't propagate.

elaine: quick check in runtime.go: retryAuth() creates http.NewRequest and never calls WithContext. That explains it.

sam: short-term fix: copy origReq.Context() to the retried request (req = req.WithContext(origCtx)). Better fix is to avoid blocking token refresh in per-request goroutines.

john: agree. Centralize refresh or return a retriable error to higher-level retry orchestration that owns context handling.

maria: I'll open a small PR: attach ctx to retry request, add unit test asserting cancel stops stream even when auth refresh is slow, and add a README note for generator onboarding.

ci-bot: buildkite: started pipeline #8912 for branch fix/ctx-cancel-auth-retry

elaine: lgtm, left two tiny style nits. Test covers cancel behavior.

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/342 — includes patch, test, and sampleapp doc blurb. Will merge once CI is green.

sam: nice catch. Add a short snippet to the generator README showing context.WithTimeout usage for interactive flows. Saves folks from copying the naive pattern.

john: also update devex onboarding note: "Avoid inline blocking token refresh in request handlers; use dedicated refresher or reattach ctx on retry."

maria: thanks all — will monitor dedicated/test matrix for flakiness after merge.
